description: Web search by meaning, not just keywords. Returns title, URL, published date and author per result; optionally page text, highlights, or one structured answer synthesised from the results. Search types: 'auto' (default, balanced), 'lite' (cheapest, fastest, no output_schema), 'deep-lite' and 'deep' (multi-step research). Categories: company, publication, news, personal site, financial report, people. max_age_hours controls freshness (0 = fetch live, -1 = cache only); historical snapshots are not available on this gateway's Exa plan. Billing note: results beyond 10 cost extra upstream. Example: exa_search({ query: "startups building AI agents for customer support", num_results: 10, type: "auto", category: "company" })

examples.query: recent research on protein folding with diffusion models
startups building AI agents for customer support
latest Federal Reserve interest rate decision

_apiKey.description: Optional, your own Exa API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

category.description: Optional focus category. Documented values: company, publication, news, 'personal site', 'financial report', people. Other strings are sent to the vendor as hints with a warning; 'tweet' is retired and refused. 'research paper' maps to publication.

include_highlights.description: If true, include the most query-relevant excerpts of each page. Default false (switched on automatically when max_age_hours is set without include_text).

include_text.description: If true, include the clean parsed page text (up to 2000 chars) for each result. Default false.

max_age_hours.description: Maximum age of page content in hours, an integer from -1 to 720. 0 fetches live content (last 60 seconds); -1 uses only the cache. Omit for the vendor default (cache).

num_results.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 100). Results beyond 10 cost extra upstream.

output_schema.description: Optional JSON schema (root type 'text' or 'object', at most 10 properties and 2 levels deep, every array with items). Returns one synthesised answer in `output` grounded in the results. Not supported with type 'lite'; adds about 2 seconds.

query.description: The search query, describe what you want by meaning, e.g. "recent research on protein folding with diffusion models"

type.description: Search type: 'auto' (balanced, default), 'lite' (low cost and latency), 'deep-lite' (light multi-step research), 'deep' (comprehensive multi-step research). Legacy neural/keyword/fast/instant/deep-reasoning are still accepted and mapped to the nearest current type with a warning.

name: exa_search

autopromptString.description: Query rewrite, when the vendor returns one

costDollars.description: Upstream cost breakdown in USD as reported by the vendor

output.description: Synthesised answer when output_schema was given: a string or an object matching the schema

text.description: Page text, when include_text is set

search_type.description: Search type actually used: auto, lite, deep-lite or deep

warnings.description: Legacy or undocumented argument values that were mapped or passed as hints
